name: suede-prospecting
description: Suede AI prospecting and qualification: defines the ICP, then builds a bounded, source-backed lead sheet across four branches (B2B SaaS, general B2B, local business, and early demand signals from forums, reviews, and public issues), using licensed data (Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clay, HubSpot Breeze Intelligence, Sales Navigator for manual research) with fit scores, disqualification evidence, source and date per contact, and CAN-SPAM, GDPR, PECR, and CASL checks before handoff. Use when defining an ICP,
author: JasonColapietro
